content:
现在我已经了解了表结构。让我编写查询：

- `production.productinventory` 包含产品库存信息（productid, locationid, quantity）
- `production.product` 包含产品名称（productid, name）

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    pi.productid AS "产品ID",
    p.name AS "产品名称",
    pi.quantity AS "数量",
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS "排名"
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4
ORDER BY pi.locationid, "排名"
